description: Minimal, spacious, high-end slide design for Paper boards. Use when creating or extending presentations in Paper that should feel keynote-like: slightly off-white backgrounds, Apple-like typography, one strong idea per slide, real UI/diagram graphics instead of text-heavy explanation, soft muted accents, obvious visual flows, and subtle section style shifts.
